item.title: The Ultimate Master Summary Guide: MySQL & SQL Fundamentals (Lectures 03–09)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: The ultimate student study guide consolidating all core SQL concepts, console commands, table creation, operators, patterns, multiple tables, and join types.

item.title: SQL Joins: Comprehensive Guide to Combining Tables (Lecture 09)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master all types of SQL joins in MySQL including INNER JOIN, LEFT/RIGHT/FULL OUTER JOIN, NATURAL JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and SELF JOIN with complete examples.

item.title: Creating & Handling Multiple Tables in a Database (Lecture 08)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master multi-table database creation, primary and foreign keys, composite keys, data insertion, aggregate functions, filtering, sorting, pattern matching, and NULL handling across relational schemas.

item.title: SQL Pattern Matching & Regular Expressions (Lecture 07)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master MySQL pattern matching using LIKE, wildcards like % and _, string length filtering, and regular expressions (REGEXP).

item.title: Sorting Data and Working with NULL in MySQL (Lecture 06)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master sorting SQL query results using ORDER BY (ASC/DESC) and handling missing or unknown data using IS NULL and IS NOT NULL operators.

item.title: Mastering SQL SELECT Statements & Filtering (SQL Part 05)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master MySQL SELECT queries, conditional filtering using WHERE, comparison operators, logical AND/OR conditions, and projecting specific columns.

item.title: Creating and Using Databases & Tables in MySQL (SQL Part 04)
item.author: Charuuu..^_^
item.description: Master database management using local MySQL console, remote PuTTY connections, and phpMyAdmin graphical user interface.

item.description: Master database management using local MySQL console, remote PuTTY connections, and phpMyAdmin graphical user interface.
